g.text: OPEN SOURCE, VENDOR-AGNOSTIC ENTERPRISE AI PLATFORM

svg.title: Gebo.ai enterprise AI architecture
svg.desc: Enterprise knowledge, users, identity, monitoring, external tools and agents connect through the Gebo.ai enterprise AI control layer to interchangeable AI models.

g.title: Your authorized users access enterprise AI through the governed Gebo.ai platform.
Gebo.ai is the enterprise AI control layer connecting users, knowledge, models, tools and agents.
Connect enterprise identity providers according to authentication and access policies.
Integrate platform monitoring with operational and security visibility systems.
External tools and systems connect through the Model Context Protocol.
External agent systems connect through the Agent-to-Agent protocol.
